title: Public NOAA/NWS RRTMGP application evidence relevant to UDM27
scope: Read-only review of official NWS notices and pinned public HAFS v2.2 source chain. No model, solver, or build run.

summary.scheduled_transition: NWS SCN 26-76 announces HAFS v2.2 effective 2026-10-13 and explicitly lists transition from RRTMG to RRTMGP. On 2026-10-06 this is scheduled, not yet effective. The release bundles many other changes; its system-level skill comparison does not isolate radiation.
summary.gfs_v17: The April 2026 NWS proposal describes RRTMG improvements. The EMC MEG page updated 2026-06-05 describes GFS v17 field evaluation and Q1 FY27 planned implementation. A GFS v17 RRTMGP development suite is not proof of operational deployment.
summary.udm27: No UDM27-specific adapter or UDM-named suite mapping was found in the inspected pinned HAFS/CCPP source. This bounded search is not proof UDM27 is unused elsewhere. HAFS scheme contracts do not validate or prescribe UDM27 policies.

source_chain.identity_limit: Pinned public branch/submodule source chain; not authenticated as a v2.2 release tag or deployed executable. SCN provides the scheduled effective date.

source_files.finding: HAFS v2 suite invokes GFS_rrtmgp_pre/cloud_mp/cloud_overlap, aerosol optics and SW/LW main; physics group invokes Thompson MP pre/main/post.

GFDL/unified path puts snow+graupel in slot 4 (581-584); paths are mixing ratio × 1e5/g × deltaP in hPa and cloud-fraction-gated (587-599). Thompson uses liquid/ice/rain/snow only (714-717), optionally smears convective condensate (728-732), derives RH-conditioned Xu-Randall cloud fraction from those species (740-744). Thompson effective radii are passed from effrin fields; stratiform ice radius is documented in microns and assigned directly at 251-257. Outer code clamps liquid/ice radii to LUT bounds (272-289). At line 300 the optional precipitation fraction is assigned from cld_frac.

Type source documents ice roughness category 1=none, 2=medium, 3=high; setter accepts a category bounded by table category count. Class initialization defaults category 1; CCPP calls setter. Effective HAFS runtime selector not established.
Loads LUT limits/optics and calls set_ice_roughness; wrapper comments/name speak of number of categories, while the underlying setter expects a category selector. Runtime input not resolved.
Loads LUT roughness dimension, permits a nonzero configured override, then calls set_ice_roughness. This is API evidence, not proof of HAFS runtime selection.
A separately named v17 RRTMGP development suite exists; it does not prove operational deployment.

limits: A development-suite name is not an operational status record.
HAFS v2.2 is a multi-change system upgrade; no radiation-only skill attribution is supported.
CCPP HAFS Thompson/GFDL mappings do not establish UDM27 hydrometeor, fraction, or radius policy.
No factor-of-two radius conclusion follows from HAFS direct assignment; UDM size metric must be compared with its pinned LUT metric.
The effective HAFS runtime ice roughness category was not established.
